decisions.why: The brief forbids app-decided lengths outside theme/token modules. The build-a-screen lesson uses a screen.stylex.ts token module, and llms.txt says media conditions live as named module constants.

decisions.choice: No in-app light/dark switch; the page follows the system preference and honours data-theme on <html>.

review.reviewer: Claude Code (cast session for #774), from the stream-json transcript, the served-request log and the agent's notes
review.rule: An intervention is an action on the project or its tooling that the guidance or CLI output did not print or link. A decision is a choice about setting up, theming or styling with Ultima that the guidance did not settle and that changed the output; product choices the brief leaves open (data, copy, arrangement, Select or Dialog) and choices between documented options are not counted. Running git init and ultima install, which init's report prints, writing a browser script for the production check the install page asks for, and building before tsc follow the guidance.
